name: dinosaurs
inputText:
Tyrannosaurus Rex — the largest land predator, 40 feet long, tiny arms, bone-crushing bite
Triceratops — three-horned dinosaur with a massive shield-like frill, plant eater
Stegosaurus — plates along its back and a spiked tail called a thagomizer, small brain
Velociraptor — fast pack hunter, about the size of a turkey, feathered, sharp curved claws
Brachiosaurus — towering long-necked herbivore, 85 feet long, could reach treetops
Pteranodon — giant flying reptile with 20-foot wingspan, not actually a dinosaur

rooms.name: Thunder Jaw Crater
rooms.itemToRemember: Tyrannosaurus Rex — largest land predator, 40 feet long, tiny arms, bone-crushing bite
rooms.mnemonic: A T-Rex stomps into a volcanic crater and tries to clap its ridiculously tiny arms — but its jaws crush a boulder instead, sending shockwaves across the ground.
rooms.sceneDescription: A massive Tyrannosaurus Rex mid-charge across a volcanic crater, one enormous foot slamming down and cracking the basalt floor, sending lava splashing upward from fissures. Its 40-foot body lunges forward with terrifying momentum, jaws wide open revealing rows of bone-crushing teeth, tiny arms flailing uselessly at its sides. Molten lava glows orange through cracks all around its thundering feet. The ground shakes visibly from the impact. Steam and sparks explode where foot meets rock. The T-Rex's muscular legs propel it forward like a living battering ram. Fiery sunset sky of purple and orange behind. Photorealistic, mid-charge action, explosive impact, cinematic wide-angle.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Massive T-Rex mid-charge across volcanic crater, enormous foot slamming down cracking basalt, lava splashing upward from fissures. Jaws wide open, bone-crushing teeth, tiny arms flailing. 40-foot body lunging with terrifying momentum. Steam and sparks exploding at impact. Fiery sunset. Photorealistic, explosive action, cinematic.

The T-Rex lunges and its massive jaws clamp down on a boulder with a thunderous crack, shattering it into fragments. Shards of rock explode outward. The bite force is visible — the boulder disintegrates like glass. Its tiny arms twitch uselessly. Lava splashes around its feet from the ground-shaking impact.

The T-Rex throws its head back and roars, fragments of crushed boulder falling from its jaws. The roar creates a visible shockwave that ripples across the crater floor, disturbing lava and sending steam spiraling. Its massive body silhouetted against the fiery orange sky. Pure apex predator dominance.

interactionButtons.label: Make it roar!
interactionButtons.prompt: The T-Rex is roaring with its enormous head thrown back, jaws gaping wide revealing rows of bone-crushing teeth, a visible shockwave rippling outward through the volcanic steam and dust, the ground cracking beneath its feet from the vibration

interactionButtons.label: Stomp the ground
interactionButtons.prompt: The T-Rex is stomping its massive foot down hard onto the volcanic crater floor, the basalt is cracking and splitting open with bright orange lava gushing upward through the fractures, shockwaves radiating outward, dust and sparks exploding from the impact point

interactionButtons.label: Tiny arm wave
interactionButtons.prompt: The T-Rex is wiggling its comically tiny arms in a confused waving motion, looking befuddled and frustrated while its massive 40-foot body towers overhead, the tiny arms flapping uselessly against its enormous muscular torso in the volcanic crater

rooms.name: Crystal Horn Fortress
rooms.itemToRemember: Triceratops — three-horned dinosaur with a massive shield-like frill, plant eater
rooms.mnemonic: Three glowing crystal horns guard a fortress gate shaped like a giant frill — but instead of attacking, the Triceratops munches flowers growing from the castle walls.
rooms.sceneDescription: A Triceratops charging full-speed through a flowering meadow, head lowered like a battering ram, three sharp horns pointed forward and gleaming in golden afternoon light. Its massive bony frill is angled forward like a shield. Its heavy body thunders across the ground, kicking up flowers and dirt with every pounding stride. An ancient vine-covered stone wall looms ahead — the Triceratops is about to smash through it. Flower petals and grass fly up in its wake. Its powerful legs drive it forward with unstoppable momentum. Warm golden light catches the textured bumpy scales. The ground shakes. Photorealistic, full-speed charge, explosive momentum, cinematic wide-angle.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Triceratops charging full-speed through flowering meadow, head lowered, three sharp horns pointed forward gleaming in golden light. Massive frill angled like a shield. Heavy body thundering, kicking up flowers and dirt. Stone wall ahead. Flower petals flying in wake. Photorealistic, full-speed charge, cinematic.

The Triceratops slams into the ancient stone wall horns-first with devastating force. The wall explodes outward — stone blocks, vines, and flower petals erupt in all directions. Its three horns punch clean through. Dust and debris billow. The frill absorbs the impact like a battering ram shield. Raw unstoppable power.

The Triceratops emerges through the shattered wall, shaking rubble and flowers off its massive frill. Stone dust rains down. It calmly lowers its head to munch on colorful flowers growing from the remaining wall, completely peaceful after the destruction. Petals drift through the golden afternoon light. Gentle giant.

interactionButtons.label: Charge forward!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Triceratops is charging at full speed through the flowering meadow, head lowered like a battering ram with three gleaming horns pointed forward, massive bony frill angled for impact, flowers and dirt flying up from its thundering feet, the ancient stone wall looming ahead about to shatter

interactionButtons.label: Shake the frill
interactionButtons.prompt: The Triceratops is shaking its enormous bony frill from side to side in a dramatic threat display, the three crystal-sharp horns catching golden afternoon light, flower petals swirling around its massive head, the ground trembling beneath its heavy body

interactionButtons.label: Munch some flowers
interactionButtons.prompt: The Triceratops is happily munching on a huge bouquet of colorful wildflowers growing from the vine-covered stone wall, its beak-like mouth gently plucking blooms, petals falling from its jaws, looking peaceful and content despite its fearsome three-horned head

rooms.name: Solar Plate Ridge
rooms.itemToRemember: Stegosaurus — plates along its back and a spiked tail called a thagomizer, small brain
rooms.mnemonic: A row of golden dinner plates lines a mountain ridge like solar panels, and at the end, four enormous spikes swing like a medieval mace — the famous 'thagomizer' named after a cartoon caveman.
rooms.sceneDescription: A Stegosaurus swinging its spiked tail in a violent arc, the four thagomizer spikes smashing through a fallen tree trunk and sending wood splinters exploding in every direction. The dinosaur's powerful body twists with the swing, its row of diamond-shaped back plates catching the golden sunrise light and glowing like solar panels in sequence. The shattered tree trunk splinters mid-impact, frozen in the moment of destruction. Wood fragments and fern fronds fly through the air. Mountain ridge at sunrise, morning mist in the valley below. The small head looks around dully, contrasting with the devastating tail weapon. Photorealistic, mid-swing impact, explosive destruction, cinematic side view.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Stegosaurus swinging spiked thagomizer tail in violent arc, four spikes smashing through fallen tree trunk, wood splinters exploding everywhere. Body twisting with swing, diamond back plates glowing golden in sunrise. Shattered trunk frozen mid-impact. Mountain ridge, morning mist below. Photorealistic, mid-swing destruction, cinematic.

The Stegosaurus completes its tail swing and the destroyed tree collapses in pieces. It stomps forward aggressively, back plates flushing red as blood pumps through them — a threat display. Each plate glows from front to back in sequence. Its tiny head swings side to side, looking for more threats despite its small brain.

The Stegosaurus rears slightly and slams its front feet down, shaking the mountain ridge. It swings the thagomizer again in a wide defensive arc — the four deadly spikes whoosh through the air at tremendous speed, shattering a rock formation. Sunrise blazes behind its row of glowing plates. Devastating weaponry on a gentle herbivore.

interactionButtons.label: Swing the tail!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Stegosaurus is swinging its spiked thagomizer tail in a devastating arc, the four deadly spikes smashing through a boulder and sending rock fragments exploding in every direction, its body twisting with the momentum, diamond-shaped back plates glowing golden in the sunrise light

interactionButtons.label: Light up plates
interactionButtons.prompt: The Stegosaurus is flushing its row of diamond-shaped back plates bright crimson red in a threat display, blood pumping visibly through each plate from front to back in a mesmerizing wave of color, the plates practically glowing against the misty mountain ridge at sunrise

interactionButtons.label: Look confused
interactionButtons.prompt: The Stegosaurus is swinging its tiny head around in bewilderment, its walnut-sized brain struggling to figure out which direction to go, bumping into a fern grove while its massive armored body and deadly tail drag behind, looking adorably dim-witted

rooms.name: Feather Sprint Hollow
rooms.itemToRemember: Velociraptor — fast pack hunter, about the size of a turkey, feathered, sharp curved claws
rooms.mnemonic: A pack of turkey-sized feathered raptors doing parkour through a jungle — each one flashing a single deadly curved claw like a switchblade as they leap between branches.
rooms.sceneDescription: Three Velociraptors mid-leap through a dense prehistoric jungle, caught in mid-air between branches at different heights. Their turkey-sized bodies are stretched out in full sprint, iridescent blue-green feathers flashing in the green-filtered light. Each one has a prominent curved sickle claw on its hind foot extended forward like a switchblade weapon. They move as a coordinated pack — one leaping left, one right, one straight ahead. Leaves and small branches shatter as they burst through the canopy. Their intelligent eyes are locked on prey. The pack moves like a single organism. Deep jungle with shafts of light cutting through. Photorealistic, mid-leap pack action, feathered detail, cinematic wide-angle.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Three Velociraptors mid-leap through dense prehistoric jungle, caught in mid-air between branches. Turkey-sized bodies stretched in full sprint, iridescent blue-green feathers flashing. Curved sickle claws extended like switchblades. Leaves shattering as they burst through canopy. Coordinated pack. Photorealistic, mid-leap action, cinematic.

The lead Velociraptor lands on a branch and instantly launches again, bouncing between trunks like parkour. Its sickle claw slashes bark as it pushes off, leaving deep gashes. The other two raptors flank from different angles, feathers ruffling with speed. Leaves explode from branches. The pack converges on a single point.

All three Velociraptors land simultaneously on a large branch, surrounding the camera. Their intelligent eyes stare directly at the viewer. Sickle claws tap against the wood. Iridescent feathers settle. One tilts its head, studying. Another hisses, showing small sharp teeth. The pack has you surrounded. Terrifyingly smart predators.

interactionButtons.label: Flash the claws!
interactionButtons.prompt: All three Velociraptors are extending their curved sickle claws forward in unison, the deadly hooked talons gleaming in shafts of jungle light, each raptor is perched on a different branch with iridescent blue-green feathers ruffled, intelligent eyes locked on the viewer

interactionButtons.label: Leap between trees
interactionButtons.prompt: The lead Velociraptor is launching itself between two massive tree trunks in a spectacular parkour leap, its feathered turkey-sized body stretched horizontally through the air, sickle claw slashing bark as it pushes off, leaves and splinters exploding from the impact point

interactionButtons.label: Pack head tilt
interactionButtons.prompt: All three Velociraptors are tilting their feathered heads in perfect synchronization, studying the viewer with eerily intelligent eyes, one is hissing softly showing small sharp teeth, iridescent blue-green plumage shimmering in the dappled jungle light, unnervingly coordinated

rooms.name: Cloud Canopy Tower
rooms.itemToRemember: Brachiosaurus — towering long-necked herbivore, 85 feet long, could reach treetops
rooms.mnemonic: A living skyscraper with a giraffe-pattern neck stretches up through the clouds to munch on a floating garden — 85 feet of pure gentle giant.
rooms.sceneDescription: An enormous Brachiosaurus crashing through a prehistoric forest, its pillar-like front legs mid-stride crushing fallen logs and undergrowth. Its incredibly long neck swings through the treetop canopy, branches snapping and leaves cascading down like a green waterfall. The 85-foot body moves like a living earthquake through the forest — trees sway and smaller ones topple as it passes. Its terracotta skin with darker giraffe-like patches catches dappled sunlight. Flocks of colorful birds erupt from the treetops as the neck sweeps through. The ground trembles with each step, dust rising around its massive feet. Seen from ground level looking up, emphasizing the staggering height. Photorealistic, mid-stride forest crash, massive scale, cinematic ultra-wide looking up.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Enormous Brachiosaurus crashing through prehistoric forest, pillar legs mid-stride crushing logs. Long neck swinging through treetop canopy, branches snapping, leaves cascading like green waterfall. 85-foot body like a living earthquake. Trees swaying and toppling. Birds erupting from canopy. Ground level looking up. Photorealistic, mid-stride, cinematic.

The Brachiosaurus's enormous head descends through the breaking canopy, pulling an entire tree branch down with its flat teeth. The branch snaps with a crack that echoes through the forest. Leaves, bark, and birds rain down. Its gentle eyes are visible — calm despite the destruction. Smaller dinosaurs scatter from its path below.

The Brachiosaurus takes another earth-shaking step, its massive foot landing and flattening a fern grove. The ground trembles, sending ripples through nearby puddles. Its neck rises back up above the canopy into golden clouds, disappearing into the sky. Dust and leaves swirl in its wake. An unstoppable gentle colossus moving through the world.

interactionButtons.label: Reach the treetops
interactionButtons.prompt: The enormous Brachiosaurus is stretching its incredibly long neck upward through the canopy, its head breaking through the treetops into golden clouds above, leaves and branches raining down, the 85-foot body reaching like a living skyscraper with its terracotta giraffe-patterned skin glowing in sunlight

interactionButtons.label: Shake the earth
interactionButtons.prompt: The Brachiosaurus is slamming one of its massive pillar-like front legs down, the ground cracking and trembling with the impact, a shockwave rippling outward through puddles and fern groves, smaller dinosaurs scattering in every direction, dust and leaves billowing upward from the earth-shaking footstep

interactionButtons.label: Gentle eye blink
interactionButtons.prompt: The Brachiosaurus is lowering its enormous head down through the canopy to eye level, blinking one gentle calm eye directly at the viewer, its huge head framed by falling leaves and broken branches, warm afternoon light catching its textured bumpy scales, a surprisingly tender moment from an 85-foot giant

rooms.name: Wingspan Cliff
rooms.itemToRemember: Pteranodon — giant flying reptile with 20-foot wingspan, not actually a dinosaur
rooms.mnemonic: A hang-glider the size of a small airplane soars over ocean cliffs with a sign around its neck: 'NOT A DINOSAUR' — because Pteranodon was a flying reptile, not a true dinosaur.
rooms.sceneDescription: A giant Pteranodon diving at high speed toward the ocean surface, wings tucked back in a steep dive, its distinctive pointed head crest cutting through the air. The 20-foot wingspan is partially folded for speed, leathery membranes rippling in the wind. The ocean surface rushes up — turquoise water with visible fish below. The Pteranodon's long beak is open, ready to snatch a fish. Wind streaks and motion blur show the incredible diving speed. Spray from the ocean surface begins to part from the approaching pressure wave. Dramatic sunset sky of orange and purple behind. Jagged coastal cliffs frame the scene. Other Pteranodons circle in the distance. Photorealistic, high-speed dive, mid-action, cinematic.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Giant Pteranodon diving at high speed toward ocean surface, wings tucked back, pointed head crest cutting through air. 20-foot wingspan partially folded, leathery membranes rippling. Ocean rushing up with visible fish. Long beak open ready to snatch. Motion blur showing speed. Sunset sky, coastal cliffs. Photorealistic, high-speed dive, cinematic.

The Pteranodon hits the water surface at speed — its beak spears through and snatches a large silver fish. An explosion of water spray erupts around it. Its enormous wings snap fully open to brake, stretching the full 20 feet. Water cascades off the leathery wing membranes. The fish thrashes in its beak.

The Pteranodon launches back into the air with powerful wingbeats, the caught fish clamped in its beak. Water streams off its body. Its 20-foot wingspan catches the orange sunset light, the thin wing membranes glowing translucent. It soars along the cliff face, crest silhouetted against the blazing sky. Majestic and alien — not a dinosaur, a flying reptile.

interactionButtons.label: Dive for fish!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Pteranodon is diving at incredible speed toward the ocean surface, wings tucked back in a steep plunge, its pointed head crest cutting through the air like a blade, the turquoise water rushing up with visible fish below, motion blur streaking past, spray beginning to part from the approaching pressure wave

interactionButtons.label: Spread the wings
interactionButtons.prompt: The Pteranodon is fully spreading its enormous 20-foot wingspan wide open, the thin leathery membranes stretching taut and glowing translucent in the orange sunset light, soaring majestically along the jagged coastal cliffs with ocean spray rising below

interactionButtons.label: Catch a fish!
interactionButtons.prompt: The Pteranodon is snatching a large silver fish from the ocean surface with its long beak, water exploding in a spectacular spray around the impact point, its enormous wings snapping fully open to brake, the caught fish thrashing and glinting in the sunset light
